title: Internal error, property list was not freed by engine!
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6.2

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.rc (c90bb52b3) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7216) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900K (32 threads) - 63.78 GiB memory

### Issue description

I'm still running into https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/115017 on:

```
Merge: 3aa4fab65d ceb9fdbd65
Author: Thaddeus Crews <repiteo@outlook.com>
Date:   Fri Mar 6 11:50:34 2026 -0600

    Merge pull request #117128 from Repiteo/4.6.2-cherry-picks-3

    [4.6] Cherry-picks for the 4.6 branch (future 4.6.2) - 3rd batch
```

Crash is on:
(https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/257ac353291f56ce1857836924a6e0625ab21b75/core/object/object.h#L199)

Backtrace:

### Steps to reproduce

I'm seeing this crash when I go to edit a NodePath in a property list which has array elements for the second time. The first time works.

Debug log:
```
godot.windows.editor.dev.x86_64.exe (26780): Loaded 'C:\Windows\System32\CoreUIComponents.dll'.
WARNING: _set:anchors/0/node_path
   at: RopeAnchorPositions::_set (src\rope_anchor_positions.cpp:87)
src\rope_anchor_positions.cpp:87 - _set:anchors/0/node_path
ERROR: Internal error, property list was not freed by engine!
```
